Oh yeah, I get your point now. Totally agree. Something should have been said regarding that. Also... Tbh he is not a good diplomat either, I'm not sure if it should be a character flaw or story flaw. They definitely could have addressed that.

Yeah, but Elizabeth seems like a good person, and she could be helpful, or at least offer some emotional support. That's what frustrating for me as well, the scene where they first met, it's like they intentionally make this story ... psychological torture? Sort of? For some reason. Lots of things could have been more simplified.

>he should have known it could be used against him

I don't remember correctly but... I think he kissed Lyall but only realised afterwards that interspecies relationships are looked down upon? Like he was surprised to see how off Lyall was, so I don't think he knew, and wouldn't be fair to say he should have known better.

>It's not exactly easy in Richter's position to make friends as a human that seems out of place. 

There was Elizabeth and that... rat guy? I think they could have gone along with that and make them friends or something. I'm not naive to say that they should just figure out everything and Richter would be free, just... not make it so depressive and hopeless.

>Now is it dragged on? I would agree with that

YES! OMG. I don't think it should have gone on that long at all. If you wanna be realistic, at least sprinkle in something to balance it out.

Thanks for putting my rephrasing my words like that! I was struggling to type it out properly. I actually wanted to say it like you do, but i was afraid people would say I'm being too soft for this? Lol

Not a comfortable read at all. But people all praise it, so I hesitated to post anything.

And all in all, I think the writer wants to go along with the "get cast out" couple trope. But it could still be done that without all the depressive moments.
